builds.name: Crushing Blow: caster and clone Q bonuses
builds.summary: Investigate high one Wukong and one clone Crushing Blow bonus output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Wukong and one clone Crushing Blow bonus output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q adds 20/45/70/95/120 + 0.5 bonus AD physical to the next attack of Wukong and his clone and removes armor. Rank-5 W lists clone damage at 60% of normal; whether and how that fraction applies to its Q bonus must be measured. Two full identical bonuses are not granted by assumption.
